# Fictional review fixture

This manuscript and ledger were written for this repository. They have no connection
to a submission, author, or commissioned review. The kernel-dimension error, imprecise
reference, and grammatical error are intentional. The underlying calculation is ordinary
linear algebra: the averaging projection has rank one and kernel dimension one less
than the number of coordinates.

The fixture supplies examples for the issue-model documentation and exercises annotation
placement and issue-list generation. Passing these tests verifies those mechanisms; it
does not validate the mathematical judgment of an automated review.
